title: Conflict Resolution
definition: Conflict resolution is the biblical process of addressing relational conflict with truth, humility, repentance, forgiveness, wisdom, and love.
summary: Conflict should be handled in ways that honor Christ, seek truth, and pursue peace.
christFocus: Jesus gives both the pattern and power for humility, truth, forgiveness, and reconciliation in conflict.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Conflict is part of life in a fallen world. Believers are not called to ignore conflict or handle it through anger, manipulation, gossip, or avoidance. Scripture gives a better way.

Biblical conflict resolution includes honest speech, careful listening, humility, repentance, forgiveness, and appropriate steps toward restoration. It seeks truth and love together.

Not every conflict is resolved quickly, and not every relationship becomes safe or fully restored immediately. Wisdom, boundaries, and church support may be needed. Still, the believer's posture should be shaped by Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Unresolved conflict can divide families, churches, and friendships. This doctrine matters because it teaches believers how to address conflict without sinfully escalating or pretending nothing is wrong.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Before addressing conflict, examine your own heart. Speak directly and gently, avoid gossip, own your part, seek forgiveness where needed, and pursue peace as far as it depends on you.
